name: Codex
description: Tier A capture: subscribes to the OpenAI Codex CLI native hook API and records every tool invocation to RedLog's timeline.
author: your-handle

capture.name: Codex (native hook)
capture.description: Records Codex CLI tool calls (command, output preview, session id, cwd) via Codex's native PostToolUse hook.

manualSteps.label: Open (or create) Codex's config file so we can register the hook
Add a [[hooks.PostToolUse]] block pointing at the RedLog hook script (see https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks)
manualSteps.command:
cat <<'TOML'
[[hooks.PostToolUse]]
matcher = ".*"

[[hooks.PostToolUse.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "{hookFile}"
timeout = 5
TOML

manualSteps.label: Restart the Codex CLI so it picks up the new hook config
Verify: run a Codex tool call, then check RedLog Settings ▸ Events for a 'codex_tool' entry
